mapper.select: SELECT a.com01_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id , a.com01_key_table AS key_table , a.com01_key_table_id AS key_table_id , a.com01_appr_id AS appr_id , b.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , b.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , b.apr01_title AS title , f_emp_kor_nm(b.apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, b.apr01_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name FROM com01_relate_appr a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.com01_appr_id WHERE com01_key_table_id = #{keyTableId} AND b.apr01_company_id = #{companyId}

WITH auth_info AS ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr04_appr_emp_id = #{empId} ) AS is_appr_emp , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr04_step_emp_id = #{empId} ) AS is_step_emp , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr13_person_auth WHERE apr13_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr13_person_id = #{empId} ) AS is_auth_emp , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr04_appr_step s WHERE s.apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND s.apr04_appr_emp_id IS NULL AND s.apr04_step_emp_id IN ( SELECT apr07_target_emp_id FROM apr07_alt_appr WHERE apr07_alt_emp_id = s.apr04_step_emp_id AND f_sysdate() BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date ) ) AS is_alt_appr ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree b ON a.apr01_class_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id INNER JOIN emp01_person e ON a.apr01_reg_emp_id = e.emp01_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp d ON a.apr01_stamp_id = apr10_stamp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth g ON a.apr01_class_tree_id = dcr03_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr03_relate_fund h ON a.apr01_appr_id = apr03_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr04_emp_auth i ON a.apr01_class_tree_id = dcr04_class_tree_id AND dcr04_person_id = #{empId} CROSS JOIN auth_info au WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr01_company_id = #{companyId} /* TOBE: 로그인 회사의 문서만 */ AND ( (
( apr01_link_cd IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys52_specific_menu_link l WHERE l.sys52_company_id = apr01_company_id AND l.sys52_link_cd = apr01_link_cd ) ) AND ( ( COALESCE(dcr04_retrieve_yn, dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') = 'true' OR au.is_appr_emp OR au.is_step_emp OR au.is_auth_emp OR au.is_alt_appr ) AND ( dcr03_org_code_id = #{orgId} OR au.is_appr_emp OR au.is_step_emp OR au.is_auth_emp OR au.is_alt_appr ) ) ) OR (
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys52_specific_menu_link l INNER JOIN sys50_specific_menu m ON l.sys52_specific_work_cd = m.sys50_specific_work_cd AND m.sys50_company_id = apr01_company_id INNER JOIN sys51_specific_menu_person p ON p.sys51_specific_menu_id = m.sys50_specific_menu_id AND p.sys51_person_id = #{empId} WHERE l.sys52_company_id = apr01_company_id AND COALESCE(p.sys51_use_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND l.sys52_link_cd = apr01_link_cd ) OR ( au.is_appr_emp OR au.is_step_emp OR au.is_auth_emp OR au.is_alt_appr ) ) )
